# Loja Integrada MCP connector

Run a Loja Integrada store from your AI: search products, update stock and prices, create products, categories and brands, follow orders, change order statuses, add tracking codes and look up customers. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 26 MCP tools for Loja Integrada: 18 read and 8 can change data.

[![Open Loja Integrada in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Dloja-integrada&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=loja-integrada)

**Category:** [E-commerce](../e-commerce.md) · **Tools:** 26 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/loja-integrada-to-mcp) · [Deutsch](https://anythingmcp.com/de/guides/loja-integrada-to-mcp) · [Italiano](https://anythingmcp.com/it/guides/loja-integrada-to-mcp) · [Español](https://anythingmcp.com/es/guides/loja-integrada-to-mcp) · [日本語](https://anythingmcp.com/ja/guides/loja-integrada-to-mcp) · [Русский](https://anythingmcp.com/ru/guides/loja-integrada-to-mcp) · [中文](https://anythingmcp.com/zh/guides/loja-integrada-to-mcp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Loja Integrada connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Loja Integrada connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your Loja Integrada account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/loja-integrada-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-loja-integrada-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-loja-integrada-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-loja-integrada-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-loja-integrada-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-loja-integrada-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-loja-integrada-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question.**

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Loja Integrada API<br/>api.awsli.com.br"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, an API key" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Loja Integrada credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (an API key), calls Loja Integrada, logs the call and returns the result.
- **Loja Integrada** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/br/loja-integrada.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/br/loja-integrada.json).

### `loja_integrada_list_products`

List the store's products, 20 per page: id, sku, nome, tipo (normal, atributo = parent with variations, atributo_opcao = variation), ativo, removido, categorias, grades, apelido, url, id_externo and resource_uri, under objects with paging in meta. Filter by SKU, active flag, removed flag or created/modified date. Prices and stock are not in this list: use loja_integrada_get_price and loja_integrada_get_stock. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /produto/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sku` | string | no | Only the product with this SKU. |
| `ativo` | boolean | no | true: only active products; false: only inactive ones. |
| `removido` | boolean | no | true: only removed products; false: hide removed ones. |
| `modified_since` | string | no | Only products modified on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. |
| `modified_until` | string | no | Only products modified on or before this date, same format. |
| `created_since` | string | no | Only products created on or after this date, same format. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_get_product`

Read one product by its Loja Integrada id (or by your id_externo): name, SKU, type, active and featured flags, categories, brand, dimensions and weight, NCM, GTIN, images, grades, parent (pai) for a variation, SEO link, and, when asked, the full HTML description. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /produto/{produto_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `produto_id` | string | yes | Product id, e.g. 202591789 (id from loja_integrada_list_products). |
| `id_externo` | `1` | no | Send 1 when the id in the path is your own id_externo instead of the Loja Integrada id; leave out otherwise. |
| `descricao_completa` | `1` | no | Send 1 to include the full HTML description. |

### `loja_integrada_create_product`

Create a product. tipo normal is a simple product; atributo creates a parent for variations, and each variation is then created with tipo atributo_opcao and pai set to the parent's URI. Price and stock are set afterwards with loja_integrada_update_price and loja_integrada_update_stock. Returns the new product with its id.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /produto/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nome` | string | yes | Product name. |
| `sku` | string | yes | SKU, unique in the store. |
| `tipo` | `normal` \| `atributo` \| `atributo_opcao` | yes | normal = simple product; atributo = parent with variations; atributo_opcao = variation (child) of a parent, which then needs pai. |
| `pai` | string | no | For tipo atributo_opcao: URI of the parent product, e.g. /api/v1/produto/202591789. |
| `apelido` | string | no | URL slug of the product page, e.g. camiseta-azul. |
| `descricao_completa` | string | no | Full description, HTML allowed. |
| `ativo` | boolean | no | Whether the product is visible in the store. |
| `destaque` | boolean | no | Whether the product is featured. |
| `usado` | boolean | no | Whether the product is used (second hand). |
| `removido` | boolean | no | true moves the product to the store's removed products. |
| `categorias` | string[] | no | Category URIs, e.g. ["/api/v1/categoria/15246059"] (resource_uri from loja_integrada_list_categories). |
| `marca` | string | no | Brand URI, e.g. /api/v1/marca/123456 (resource_uri from loja_integrada_list_brands). |
| `peso` | number | no | Weight in kg, e.g. 0.35. |
| `altura` | integer | no | Height in cm. |
| `largura` | integer | no | Width in cm. |
| `profundidade` | integer | no | Depth in cm. |
| `ncm` | string | no | NCM tax code (8 digits). |
| `gtin` | string | no | GTIN / EAN barcode. |
| `mpn` | string | no | Manufacturer part number. |
| `id_externo` | integer | no | Your own id for the product in another system. If the product has one, its categories need one too. |

### `loja_integrada_update_product`

Update a product. Loja Integrada replaces the product with what is sent, so first read it with loja_integrada_get_product and send every field again with your changes (fields left out may be cleared). Price and stock are not changed here. Returns the updated product.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /produto/{produto_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `produto_id` | string | yes | Product id (or your id_externo with id_externo_lookup 1). |
| `id_externo_lookup` | `1` | no | Send 1 when produto_id is your id_externo. |
| `nome` | string | yes | Product name. |
| `sku` | string | yes | SKU, unique in the store. |
| `tipo` | `normal` \| `atributo` \| `atributo_opcao` | yes | normal = simple product; atributo = parent with variations; atributo_opcao = variation (child) of a parent, which then needs pai. |
| `pai` | string | no | For tipo atributo_opcao: URI of the parent product, e.g. /api/v1/produto/202591789. |
| `apelido` | string | no | URL slug of the product page, e.g. camiseta-azul. |
| `descricao_completa` | string | no | Full description, HTML allowed. |
| `ativo` | boolean | no | Whether the product is visible in the store. |
| `destaque` | boolean | no | Whether the product is featured. |
| `usado` | boolean | no | Whether the product is used (second hand). |
| `removido` | boolean | no | true moves the product to the store's removed products. |
| `categorias` | string[] | no | Category URIs, e.g. ["/api/v1/categoria/15246059"] (resource_uri from loja_integrada_list_categories). |
| `marca` | string | no | Brand URI, e.g. /api/v1/marca/123456 (resource_uri from loja_integrada_list_brands). |
| `peso` | number | no | Weight in kg, e.g. 0.35. |
| `altura` | integer | no | Height in cm. |
| `largura` | integer | no | Width in cm. |
| `profundidade` | integer | no | Depth in cm. |
| `ncm` | string | no | NCM tax code (8 digits). |
| `gtin` | string | no | GTIN / EAN barcode. |
| `mpn` | string | no | Manufacturer part number. |
| `id_externo` | integer | no | Your own id for the product in another system. If the product has one, its categories need one too. |

### `loja_integrada_list_stock`

List the stock records of all products, 20 per page: produto URI, quantidade (quantity), quantidade_reservada (reserved by orders), quantidade_disponivel, gerenciado (whether stock is tracked) and the availability (situacao) shown with and without stock. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /produto_estoque/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_get_stock`

Read the stock of one product or variation: quantity, reserved and available quantity, whether stock is managed, and the availability situations used with and without stock. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /produto_estoque/{produto_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `produto_id` | string | yes | Product or variation id. |

### `loja_integrada_update_stock`

Set the stock of one product or variation: quantidade (absolute quantity, not a delta), gerenciado (track stock) and the availability ids shown with and without stock. For a product with variations, set the stock on each variation. Returns the updated stock record.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /produto_estoque/{produto_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `produto_id` | string | yes | Product or variation id. |
| `quantidade` | integer | no | New quantity in stock (absolute value). |
| `gerenciado` | boolean | no | true: Loja Integrada tracks the quantity and stops selling at zero, depending on the situations. |
| `situacao_em_estoque` | integer | no | Availability id shown while in stock (0 = available now). |
| `situacao_sem_estoque` | integer | no | Availability id shown when out of stock (for example -1 = unavailable). |

### `loja_integrada_list_prices`

List the prices of all products, 20 per page: produto URI, cheio (list price), promocional (sale price), custo (cost) and sob_consulta (price on request). Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /produto_preco/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_get_price`

Read the prices of one product or variation: cheio (list price), promocional (sale price, null when none), custo (cost) and sob_consulta. Amounts come as strings such as "32.83" in BRL. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /produto_preco/{produto_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `produto_id` | string | yes | Product or variation id (or your id_externo with id_externo 1). |
| `id_externo` | `1` | no | Send 1 when the id in the path is your own id_externo instead of the Loja Integrada id; leave out otherwise. |

### `loja_integrada_update_price`

Change the prices of one product or variation: cheio (list price), promocional (sale price; send 0 or null to remove it), custo (cost) and sob_consulta (show 'price on request' instead of a price). Prices are in BRL. Confirm new prices with the user before calling. Returns the updated price record.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /produto_preco/{produto_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `produto_id` | string | yes | Product or variation id (or your id_externo with id_externo 1). |
| `id_externo` | `1` | no | Send 1 when the id in the path is your own id_externo instead of the Loja Integrada id; leave out otherwise. |
| `cheio` | number | no | List price in BRL, e.g. 129.90. |
| `promocional` | number | no | Sale price in BRL, lower than cheio. |
| `custo` | number | no | Cost price in BRL. |
| `sob_consulta` | boolean | no | true: show 'price on request'. |

### `loja_integrada_list_categories`

List the store's categories: id, nome, descricao, categoria_pai (parent URI), id_externo, url and resource_uri. Use resource_uri in a product's categorias. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /categoria/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_create_category`

Create a category, optionally below a parent category. Returns the new category with its id and resource_uri.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /categoria/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nome` | string | yes | Category name. |
| `descricao` | string | no | Description. |
| `categoria_pai` | string | no | Parent category URI, e.g. /api/v1/categoria/7645875. |
| `id_externo` | integer | no | Your own id for the category. |

### `loja_integrada_list_brands`

List the store's brands: id, nome, apelido, descricao, id_externo and resource_uri. Use resource_uri as a product's marca. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /marca/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_create_brand`

Create a brand. Returns the new brand with its id and resource_uri.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /marca/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nome` | string | yes | Brand name. |
| `apelido` | string | no | URL slug, e.g. marca-nova. |
| `descricao` | string | no | Description. |
| `id_externo` | integer | no | Your own id for the brand. |

### `loja_integrada_list_grids`

List the variation grids (grades, e.g. Tamanho, Cor) of the store, including the system's default grids: id, nome, nome_visivel and resource_uri. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /grades/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_get_grid`

Read one variation grid with its variations (values such as P, M, G or Azul), each with id and nome. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /grades/{grade_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grade_id` | string | yes | Grid id from loja_integrada_list_grids. |

### `loja_integrada_search_orders`

Search orders, 20 per page (at most 50): numero (order number), situacao (status with codigo and nome), cliente URI, valor_total, created/modified/expiry dates and resource_uri. Filter by status id, payment method id, customer id, order number from, and created or updated date. Read details with loja_integrada_get_order. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /pedido/search/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `situacao_id` | integer | no | Only orders in this status (numeric id from loja_integrada_list_order_statuses). |
| `pagamento_id` | integer | no | Only orders paid with this payment method (id from loja_integrada_list_payment_methods). |
| `cliente_id` | integer | no | Only orders of this customer. |
| `since_numero` | integer | no | Only orders with a number equal to or greater than this. |
| `since_criado` | string | no | Only orders created from this moment, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (time optional). |
| `until_criado` | string | no | Only orders created before this moment, same format. |
| `since_atualizado` | string | no | Only orders updated from this moment, same format. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_get_order`

Read one order by its number: customer, billing and delivery address, items (itens with SKU, quantity and prices), payments, shipments (envios with id, shipping method, tracking objeto, price and deadline), status, coupon, totals and dates. The shipment id (envios[].id) is what loja_integrada_update_tracking_code needs. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /pedido/{numero}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `numero` | integer | yes | Order number, e.g. 164. |

### `loja_integrada_list_order_statuses`

List the order statuses of the store: id, codigo (e.g. aguardando_pagamento, pedido_pago, pedido_enviado, pedido_entregue, pedido_cancelado), nome, and the aprovado, cancelado and final flags. Use codigo with loja_integrada_update_order_status and id with loja_integrada_search_orders. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /situacao/`

No parameters.

### `loja_integrada_update_order_status`

Move an order to another status by its codigo, for example pedido_pago, pedido_em_separacao, faturado, pedido_enviado, pronto_para_retirada, pedido_entregue or pedido_cancelado. Loja Integrada may e-mail the buyer and a final status (such as cancelled) cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first. Returns the new status.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /situacao/pedido/{numero}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `numero` | integer | yes | Order number. |
| `codigo` | string | yes | Target status codigo from loja_integrada_list_order_statuses. |

### `loja_integrada_get_order_status_history`

Read the status history of one order: each change with its date, the new and previous status and who changed it (alterado_por_nome), by order number or by your id_externo. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /situacao_historico/search/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `numero` | integer | no | Order number. |
| `id_externo` | integer | no | Your own id for the order, instead of numero. |

### `loja_integrada_update_tracking_code`

Set the tracking code of one shipment of an order. Use the shipment id from loja_integrada_get_order (envios[].id), not the order number. Returns the updated shipment.

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /pedido_envio/{pedido_envio_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pedido_envio_id` | integer | yes | Shipment id, envios[].id of the order (e.g. 69291055). |
| `objeto` | string | yes | Tracking code, e.g. AA123456789BR. |

### `loja_integrada_list_payment_methods`

List the payment methods of the store: id, nome, codigo and configuracoes (ativo, disponivel). Use the id to filter loja_integrada_search_orders by payment method. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /pagamento/`

No parameters.

### `loja_integrada_list_customers`

List customers, 20 per page: id, nome, email, cpf or cnpj, phone numbers, sexo, data_nascimento, group and dates. Sort by modification date. Use loja_integrada_search_customers to find one by e-mail. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /cliente/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_by` | `data_modificacao` \| `-data_modificacao` | no | Sort by modification date, oldest (data_modificacao) or newest (-data_modificacao) first. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_search_customers`

Search customers by e-mail and/or a created or updated date window; date-filtered results come newest modification first. Returns the matching customers with id, nome, email, cpf/cnpj and phones. Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /cliente/search/`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cliente_email` | string | no | Exact customer e-mail. |
| `since_criado` | string | no | Created from this date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. |
| `until_criado` | string | no | Created until this date, same format. |
| `since_atualizado` | string | no | Updated from this date, same format. |
| `until_atualizado` | string | no | Updated until this date, same format. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Items per page (default 20, at most 50). |
| `offset` | integer | no | Position of the first item: 0, then 20, 40 ... (meta.next shows the next offset; it is null on the last page). |

### `loja_integrada_get_customer`

Read one customer by id: name, e-mail, CPF or CNPJ, company name, phones, birth date, group and addresses (enderecos). Read-only.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /cliente/{cliente_id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cliente_id` | string | yes | Customer id, e.g. 34220641 (also the number at the end of an order's cliente URI). |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Loja Integrada** and enter `LOJA_INTEGRADA_API_KEY`, `LOJA_INTEGRADA_APP_KEY`, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
